description: Single authoritative, versioned, machine-readable source of public distribution display labels for Task 23.7.5.12 public compatibility documentation generation. Keyed by the exact manifest distribution id (compat/compatibility.json distributions.<id>.id). Presentation-only: it does not define support, certification, policy, or classification facts, which come only from the compatibility manifest and compat/support_model.py. Do not duplicate these values in generator code, tests, fixtures, comments, or any second policy file.
